# colvmn

> A minimal static-site layout engine.

Site build: colvmn · 2026-11-13 · b6b227c

## AI Reviews

- [AI Reviews](/ai-reviews/): Any page can have Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok review it and everything below it, from its own docs. One setting on the page and an API key; colvmn does the rest.

## Authoring

## Quick Start

- [Quick Start](/quick-start/)

## Scheduled Updates

- [Scheduled Updates](/scheduled-updates/): Pages that refresh themselves. A folder with an update file runs a script or a prompt on a schedule, or when what it watches changes, and publishes the result.
